name: Off The Brook Bistro & Cocktails

evidence.note: Official site lists live music Friday and Saturday 7-9 pm, brunch and happy hour; parking in rear.
Reservation page lists upcoming solo and duo performers; no mention of dancing.
Review summaries describe a cute, cozy bistro with live music and events.

dancing.notes: This is a cozy dinner spot with live music from about 7 to 9 pm on Fridays and Saturdays. We found no reports of people dancing, so expect a sit-down crowd.

description: A small Italian-American bistro and cocktail bar on Merrick Road with brunch on weekends and live local music on Friday and Saturday evenings. Parking is behind the building.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Address confirmed by Ira's List venue page (/off-the-brook): 1810 Merrick Rd, Merrick, parking in rear, phone 516-608-6543. Oceanwalk gig on Oct 3 not checked on the venue's own calendar.
